en.value: _____ of on eye contains about 1 million optic nerve fibres (which transmit information to the brain).

english.explanation: When light hits the retina (a light sensitive layer of tissue at the back of eye) special cells called Photoreceptors turn the light into electrical signals. These electrical signal travel from the retina through the optic nerve to, the brain. The brain turns the signals into the images we see. Optic nerves are present just behind the retina & connected to retina. Optic nerve is the second of several pairs of cranial nerves. It transmits sensory information for vision in the form of electrical impulses from eye to brain.
